Cai_init.data_reference: definitional; resting cytosolic Ca 1e-4 mM (the soma's Cai_init, cf. wanaverbecq2003plasma), the Ca at which z starts

E_K.data_reference: definitional; Nernst potential RT/F ln(Ko/Ki) at Ko 4.5, Ki 200 mM, 295.15 K (the soma defaults; used when unconnected)

Q10_BK.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; conventional gating Q10 (no effect while T_ref = T)
